content.text:
## Root cause: “only categories works”

Tabs and submit handlers for Tasks, Rewards, and Punishments were already wired (`addTask`, `addReward`, `addPunishmentTemplate`). The main functional bug was in **Tasks**:

- The category `<select>` displayed the first category via `value={draft.categoryId || state.categories[0]?.id}`, but **`draft.categoryId` could stay `''`**.
- Submit/validation used `draft.categoryId`, so **Create task failed** with “Select a category” even though the UI looked correct.
- **Categories** only need a name; **Rewards/Punishments** only need a title — so those tabs appeared to work while Tasks did not.

A secondary UX issue: when there were no categories, the Tasks tab showed only an empty state **with no form** (now it always shows the form with a clear banner).

## Root cause: phone layout on PC

`.app-main` and `.app-header` are capped at **`max-width: 30rem`** globally. Admin only bumped that to `52rem` at 720px+, so on a wide monitor the admin UI still looked like a narrow centered phone column.

## Files changed

| File | Change |
|------|--------|
| `src/pages/Admin.tsx` | Resolve `categoryId` on submit; always show Tasks list+form; disable task actions when no categories |
| `src/components/Layout.tsx` | Add `app-shell--admin-full` on `/admin` routes |
| `src/index.css` | Full-width admin layout; wider two-column panel at 1024px+ |
| `src/lib/storage.ts` | `saveState` returns `boolean` (handles quota errors) |
| `src/hooks/useAppStore.tsx` | Warn when save fails |

## Breakpoint behavior

| Viewport | Admin layout |
|----------|----------------|
| **< 560px** | Single column: list above form |
| **560px – 1023px** | Two columns inside full-width main (`1fr` / `1.05fr`) |
| **768px+** | Full viewport width, **2rem** horizontal padding on header/main |
| **1024px+** | List column grows; form column `22rem–32rem`; **no** 30rem/52rem cap |

Sticky admin tabs span the full admin content width. Category image picker is unchanged.
